claims.text: DARPA states it was 'Created in response to the launch of Sputnik in 1957' and is 'an independent research and development agency within the U.S. Department of War (DOW)', with six technical offices.
DARPA's published budget figures as of 2026 are a President's FY2027 request of $5.039 billion and an FY2026 enacted level of $4.322 billion.
